title: Evals signal synthesis: Console routing, enrichment, and noise suppression for model/config rollouts
creator: Anita Rao
description: Provide a concerted pipeline that synthesizes evals-derived quality signals tied to config and model changes, enriches those signals with provenance and metric deltas, and routes deduplicated actionable notices into Console notification sinks (Slack/PagerDuty) with configurable suppression windows and priority escalation. The feature should reduce noise for platform and customer-facing alerts while preserving fidelity for true regressions during model or config rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Console shows per-change eval snapshot with visual delta and top contributing tests within 5s of ingestion
Notifications sent to Slack and PagerDuty include a stable signal fingerprint and provenance link to the eval snapshot and related PRs
A dedupe policy (temporal-window + signature hashing) prevents duplicate notifications for the same regression across up to 3 backfilled sources
Operators can configure per-project suppression windows and severity mapping in Console UI
Signal enrichment includes model version, config diff summary, dataset slice, and confidence scores
Regression notices include automated suggested rollback or canary recommendations when impact > threshold
End-to-end integration tests simulate a model swap and assert exactly one high-priority PagerDuty incident and 0-2 Slack threads depending on routing config
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (MVP): infrastructure to ingest eval change events with minimal provenance, compute deltas, produce a canonical fingerprint; wire to existing Console notification broker
Phase 2: add enrichment pipeline (model metadata, PR links, config diffs) and UI delta visualization; implement basic suppression windows
Phase 3: advanced dedupe (signature family clustering, cross-project correlation), rollout-aware escalation (canary-aware thresholds), and operator controls in Console settings
Parallel: security review and KMS integration for any sensitive eval artifacts stored with snapshots
design_notes: PM/Design decision: show both absolute metric delta and relative % change; color-code micro-regressions vs critical failures
Wireframe: compact timeline card per-change, expand to detailed snapshot with side-by-side baseline/current test outputs
UX trade-off: default suppression window set to 15 minutes for noise control; power users can set custom windows per-project
Accessibility: ensure delta charts have text summaries for screen readers
engineering_notes: ENG feedback (2025-02-20): prefer computing canonical fingerprint using SHA256 over sorted tuple of <test_id, model_hash, config_hash, top-failed-ids> to aid deterministic dedupe
Runtime: ingest events from evals pipeline (Kafka topic: evals.change.v1) and enrich via model-metadata service (ENG-20577 changes needed)
Storage: snapshot pointers (S3 URNs) stored in Console DB; full artifacts retained per retention policy (default 30 days)
Rate-limiting: tie notification fanout to project quota; implement backpressure to avoid alert storms during mass rollouts
Observability: add metrics for signal ingestion latency, dedupe-hit-rate, suppression-window-trigger-count
integration_spec: Slack payload: include title, fingerprint, short delta summary (3 lines), link to snapshot, suggested action, and a block with top failing prompts
PagerDuty: trigger only for severity >= P1; attach snapshot URL and fingerprint; include automatic dedupe key = fingerprint
Webhook: provide optional JSON webhook with full enriched payload for downstream tooling
Auth: use Console service token with scoped capability to read eval snapshots; ensure token rotation per org policy
rollout_strategy: Start with internal beta: roll to platform team projects only for 2 weeks
Opt-in for customer projects during canary phase; collect feedback and adjust suppression defaults
Full rollout gated on dedupe-hit-rate < 0.25 and mean time to acknowledge for P1 < 30 mins
Provide opt-out toggle at org level and per-project controls for Slack/PagerDuty routing
testing_plan: Unit tests for fingerprint generation and signature collision edge cases
Synthetic integration test: simulate concurrent model/config changes across 5 projects and assert dedupe behavior
E2E staging test: deploy with a controlled eval that introduces a minor regression and ensure only one Slack thread is created when suppression enabled
Load test: flood pipeline with 10k eval change events and measure Console ingestion latency and notification broker throughput
